definitions.unit: One original entry per match, flat stake 1, full-time Asian over settlement.
definitions.earlier_recorded: First recorded exact-price strong v8 entry per match before the epoch. Historical protocols differ from the frozen common Top5.
definitions.current_primary: Original canonical epoch ledger, settled and originally priced only. Original outcomes override conservative broad-archive conflict exclusions.
definitions.earlier_observed: Sensitivity: first exact-price strong v8 opportunity, whether recorded as a model entry or not.
definitions.counterfactual: Subset of original entries; rejected entries are not replaced with later opportunities or sixth-ranked matches.
definitions.night: Entry timestamp, not kickoff; Moscow local time 00:00 inclusive to 08:00 exclusive.
definitions.goal_profile: Average of the two teams same-league mean match totals, divided by league mean; >=1.1 means at least 10% above that league baseline.
definitions.uncertainty: Descriptive match bootstrap only; ignores within-league/day dependence and multiple selection. Historical analyses are not untouched validation.
definitions.causality: Loss concentrations and candidate restrictions, not proof that time or historical scoring causes losses.
definitions.execution: Saved API prices; not a claim of verified executable bookmaker prices.

source_audit.strong_gate: Complete required data, fresh finishing, continuation, and either recent SOT/supported xG or same-team shots in adjacent intervals. No calibrated win probability.
source_audit.pressure_presence: persistent_dangerous_pressure tests positive aggregate counts in both observed intervals; it has no calibrated minimum intensity.
source_audit.ranking: All eligible events necessarily have evidence class 0, window 5; remaining order uses SOT rate, finishing rate, two-sided finishing, dangerous-attacks rate, goal-profile ratio, event ID.
source_audit.market: Sports admission/ranking does not use total line or price; a separately recorded Poisson EV subset is assessed in existing_ev_filter.
source_audit.goal_profile_role: A higher ratio is only a late tie-breaker. Its losing subgroup is not proof that this tie-breaker caused the losses.

raw_example.match: Harju JK Laagri - FC Flora Tallinn
raw_example.interpretation: Illustrates the qualitative strength label only; one losing example does not establish a profitable replacement threshold.

ranking_capacity.scope_limit: Only saved exact-priced enriched observations, not unseen/unpriced board matches. Ever selected is not same-cycle selected.
